items.title: WST Q3 deep dive: Biologics and regulatory tailwinds fuel margin expansion, HVP mix shift continues
items.summary: Healthcare products company West Pharmaceutical Services (NYSE:WST) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 2026, with sales up 8.7% year on year to $874.5 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $3.42 billion at the midpoint came in 1.2% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.66 per share was 21.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
